name: Chao gao luc
summary: Brown rice cooked soft and eaten with braised fish, chili, and green dưa gang melon. A light bowl for the evening.
origin: Hoi An. The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 4 September 2024 article, republishing Dân Việt, also calls it cháo gạo đỏ and places it in the lanes at night.
howToEat: Eat it with a spoon. The article pairs the porridge with braised fish, chili, and dưa gang.
seoTitle: Chao gao luc — brown-rice porridge in Hoi An
seoDescription: Cháo gạo lức is Hoi An’s evening brown-rice porridge, with braised fish, chili, and green winter melon.
